subtitle.en: Matric year: choosing courses, applications and NSFAS
subtitle.zu: Unyaka we-matric: ukukhetha izifundo, izicelo ne-NSFAS

blurb.en: Choosing a course, application fees, funding forms and results day. About 5 minutes.
blurb.zu: Ukukhetha isifundo, izimali zezicelo, amafomu oxhaso nosuku lwemiphumela. Cishe imizuzu emi-5.

text.en: Applications open soon. You love one subject, another course pays better, and your marks fit a third. Everyone has an opinion.
text.zu: Izicelo zivulwa maduze. Uthanda isifundo esisodwa, esinye siholela kangcono, futhi amamaki akho afanele esesithathu. Wonke umuntu unombono.

outcome.en: You choose the subject you'd study for free. Now check what its graduates actually do.
outcome.zu: Ukhetha isifundo obungasifunda mahhala. Manje hlola ukuthi abaphothule kuso benzani ngempela.

outcome.en: The salary looks good on paper. Four years is a long time in a course you don't enjoy.
outcome.zu: Iholo libukeka lilihle ephepheni. Iminyaka emine yisikhathi eside esifundweni ongasijabuleli.

outcome.en: The advisor shows you courses that fit your marks, your interests and the job market.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukukhombisa izifundo ezifanele amamaki akho, izintshisekelo zakho nemakethe yemisebenzi.

tip.en: University career offices and open days answer questions from learners too.
tip.zu: Amahhovisi emisebenzi asenyuvesi nezinsuku ezivulekile aphendula nemibuzo yabafundi besikole.

title.en: Your friends are all applying to one university
title.zu: Abangane bakho bonke bafaka isicelo enyuvesi eyodwa

text.en: Your whole group is applying to the same university. It doesn't offer your first-choice course, but you wouldn't be alone.
text.zu: Iqembu lakho lonke lifaka isicelo enyuvesi efanayo. Ayinaso isifundo sakho sokuqala, kodwa ubungeke ube wedwa.

outcome.en: You apply where your friends apply. You'll arrive knowing someone, in your second-choice course.
outcome.zu: Ufaka isicelo lapho abangane bakho befaka khona. Uzofika wazi othile, esifundweni sakho sesibili.

outcome.en: You compare courses, costs and distance. One university fits you better than it fits your friends.
outcome.zu: Uqhathanisa izifundo, izindleko nebanga. Inyuvesi eyodwa ikufanela kangcono kunabangane bakho.

outcome.en: It costs one more application fee, and it keeps both doors open.
outcome.zu: Kubiza imali eyodwa eyengeziwe yesicelo, futhi kugcina iminyango yomibili ivulekile.

text.en: Outside the internet café, a man offers to do your university and NSFAS applications for R150. He needs your ID number and a password. You have {money}.
text.zu: Ngaphandle kwe-internet café, indoda ithi ingakwenzela izicelo zakho zenyuvesi ne-NSFAS ngo-R150. Idinga inombolo yakho kamazisi nephasiwedi. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: He takes the R150 and your details, and nothing is ever submitted. Now a stranger has your ID number and your password.
outcome.zu: Uthatha u-R150 nemininingwane yakho, futhi akukho okuthunyelwayo. Manje umuntu ongamazi unenombolo yakho kamazisi nephasiwedi yakho.

tip.en: Applying is something you do yourself, on official websites. If this happens, change your passwords and tell your school.
tip.zu: Ukufaka isicelo yinto oyenza wena, kumawebhusayithi asemthethweni. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, shintsha amaphasiwedi akho futhi utshele isikole sakho.

outcome.en: It takes an afternoon and a lot of scanning. Every reference number and password is yours alone.
outcome.zu: Kuthatha intambama nokuskena okuningi. Yonke inombolo yereferensi nephasiwedi ngeyakho wedwa.

outcome.en: Your LO teacher sits with you at the school computer. You apply yourself, on the official websites, and it costs nothing.
outcome.zu: Uthisha wakho we-LO uhlala nawe kukhompyutha yesikole. Uzifakela wena, kumawebhusayithi asemthethweni, futhi akubizi lutho.

title.en: Your family wants you closer to home
title.zu: Umndeni wakho ufuna ube seduze nekhaya

text.en: Your family wants you to study close to home, or to choose the course an uncle recommends. They're worried, and they're also paying attention.
text.zu: Umndeni wakho ufuna ufunde eduze nekhaya, noma ukhethe isifundo esinconywa ngumalume. Bakhathazekile, futhi banakile.

outcome.en: Home is happier. You wonder about the course you didn't choose.
outcome.zu: Ikhaya lijabule kakhulu. Uyazibuza ngesifundo ongasikhethanga.

outcome.en: You show them the costs, the funding and how often you'd come home. They agree to one application further away.
outcome.zu: Ubakhombisa izindleko, uxhaso nokuthi uzobuya kangaki ekhaya. Bavuma isicelo esisodwa esikude.

outcome.en: You apply where you planned. Supper is quiet for a week, then your mother asks about res.
outcome.zu: Ufaka isicelo lapho ubuhlele khona. Isidlo sakusihlwa sithule isonto, bese umama wakho ebuza nge-res.

text.en: Each application costs about R200, and closing dates are different everywhere. You have {money}.
text.zu: Isicelo ngasinye sibiza cishe u-R200, futhi izinsuku zokuvala ziyahluka yonke indawo. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: One fee, one form, and everything rides on it.
outcome.zu: Imali eyodwa, ifomu elilodwa, futhi konke kuncike kulo.

outcome.en: It costs R600, and you have three chances instead of one.
outcome.zu: Kubiza u-R600, futhi unamathuba amathathu esikhundleni selilodwa.

outcome.en: Some universities don't charge for online applications, and others waive the fee if you ask. You apply to three for R200.
outcome.zu: Amanye amanyuvesi awakhokhisi ngezicelo ze-inthanethi, kanti amanye ayayixolela imali uma ucela. Ufaka izicelo ezintathu ngo-R200.

tip.en: Ask each university about application fee waivers before you pay.
tip.zu: Buza inyuvesi ngayinye ngokuxolelwa kwemali yesicelo ngaphambi kokukhokha.

text.en: The NSFAS form wants a signed consent form from a parent, and the name on your ID doesn't match your school records.
text.zu: Ifomu le-NSFAS lifuna ifomu lemvume elisayinwe ngumzali, futhi igama elisemazisini wakho alihambisani namarekhodi esikole.

outcome.en: The application sits as "incomplete" for weeks. You only find out in January.
outcome.zu: Isicelo sihlala "singaphelele" amasonto. Uthola lokho ngoJanuwari kuphela.

outcome.en: It takes two trips and an affidavit. Your details match, and the form goes through.
outcome.zu: Kuthatha uhambo olubili ne-affidavit. Imininingwane yakho iyahambisana, futhi ifomu liyadlula.

tip.en: A police station can commission an affidavit for free, and your school can certify copies of your documents.
tip.zu: Isiteshi samaphoyisa singafungisa i-affidavit mahhala, futhi isikole sakho singaqinisekisa amakhophi amadokhumenti akho.

outcome.en: Your LO teacher helps you upload the consent form and check every detail against your ID.
outcome.zu: Uthisha wakho we-LO ukusiza ulayishe ifomu lemvume futhi uhlole yonke imininingwane nomazisi wakho.

tip.en: Missing documents are the most common reason funding applications stall. Check your status after you submit.
tip.zu: Amadokhumenti angekho yisizathu esivame kakhulu sokuma kwezicelo zoxhaso. Hlola isimo sakho emva kokuthumela.

text.en: While you wait for results, you look for a room. A page called "Student Rooms Near Campus" says spaces are almost gone: send R300 today to hold one. You have {money}.
text.zu: Ngenkathi ulinde imiphumela, ufuna ikamelo. Ikhasi elibizwa ngokuthi "Student Rooms Near Campus" lithi izindawo sezizophela: thumela u-R300 namuhla ukuze ubambe eyodwa. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: The page takes your R300 and blocks you. No real residence asks for a holding fee by message before you have seen a lease.
outcome.zu: Ikhasi lithatha u-R300 wakho bese likuvimba. Ayikho indawo yokuhlala yangempela ecela imali yokubamba ngomlayezo ngaphambi kokuba ubone isivumelwano.

tip.en: "Pay today or lose it" is the warning sign. Only pay into an account you can match to the university or an accredited provider.
tip.zu: "Khokha namuhla noma ulahlekelwe" yisibonakaliso sexwayiso. Khokha kuphela ku-akhawunti ongayihlanganisa nenyuvesi noma nomhlinzeki ogunyaziwe.

outcome.en: You apply on the university's own website, before the closing date. Res applications close early, often months before classes start.
outcome.zu: Ufaka isicelo kuwebhusayithi yenyuvesi uqobo, ngaphambi kosuku lokuvala. Izicelo ze-res zivalwa kusenesikhathi, ngokuvamile ezinyangeni ngaphambi kokuqala kwezifundo.

outcome.en: The accommodation office sends its list of accredited private residences. The page asking for R300 is not on it.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala lithumela uhlu lwalo lwezindawo ezizimele ezigunyaziwe. Ikhasi elicela u-R300 alikho kulo.

tip.en: If you are on NSFAS, private accommodation must be accredited or your rent won't be paid. Check the list before you sign anything.
tip.zu: Uma use-NSFAS, indawo yokuhlala ezimele kufanele igunyazwe kungenjalo irenti yakho ngeke ikhokhwe. Hlola uhlu ngaphambi kokusayina noma yini.

text.en: Your matric results are out, and they're lower than you expected. Your first-choice course needed a few more points.
text.zu: Imiphumela yakho ye-matric isiphumile, futhi iphansi kunalokho obukulindele. Isifundo sakho sokuqala besidinga amaphuzu ambalwa engeziwe.

outcome.en: You switch off your phone for two days. When you switch it back on, the choices are still waiting for you.
outcome.zu: Ucisha ifoni yakho izinsuku ezimbili. Uma uyivula futhi, izinqumo zisakulindile.

outcome.en: You still qualify for your second choice, and for an extended programme in your first.
outcome.zu: Usafanelekela ukukhetha kwakho kwesibili, nohlelo olwelulwe kokwakho kokuqala.

tip.en: Each university's website lists the minimum points for every course. Call or email the admissions office to confirm your options.
tip.zu: Iwebhusayithi yenyuvesi ngayinye ibala amaphuzu amancane esifundo ngasinye. Shayela noma uthumele i-imeyili ehhovisi lokwamukelwa ukuze uqinisekise izindlela zakho.

label.en: Rewrite, and apply again next year
label.zu: Bhala kabusha, bese ufaka isicelo futhi ngonyaka ozayo

outcome.en: You won't start university this year. You'll rewrite the subjects you need, and apply again next year for the course you really want.
outcome.zu: Ngeke uqale inyuvesi kulo nyaka. Uzobhala kabusha izifundo ozidingayo, bese ufaka isicelo futhi ngonyaka ozayo sesifundo osifuna ngempela.

tip.en: Ask your school how to register for the supplementary or Second Chance exams, and when registration closes. Then check when applications for next year open.
tip.zu: Buza esikoleni sakho ukuthi ubhalisela kanjani izivivinyo ezengeziwe noma ze-Second Chance, nokuthi ukubhalisa kuvalwa nini. Bese uhlola ukuthi izicelo zonyaka ozayo zivulwa nini.

text.en: Your phone is back on. Your first-choice course is out of reach this year, but other doors haven't closed. What now?
text.zu: Ifoni yakho isivuliwe. Isifundo sakho sokuqala asifinyeleleki kulo nyaka, kodwa eminye iminyango ayivalekanga. Manje kuthiwani?

outcome.en: You check the points: you still qualify for your second choice. You accept the offer before it closes.
outcome.zu: Uhlola amaphuzu: usafanelekela ukukhetha kwakho kwesibili. Wamukela isipho ngaphambi kokuthi sivalwe.

tip.en: Each university lists the minimum points for every course. Call or email admissions to confirm before the offer closes.
tip.zu: Inyuvesi ngayinye ibala amaphuzu amancane esifundo ngasinye. Shayela noma uthumele i-imeyili ehhovisi lokwamukelwa ukuze uqinisekise ngaphambi kokuthi isipho sivalwe.

label.en: Look for something that fits better

outcome.en: Admissions points you to an extended programme in your first-choice course: one extra year, and the same degree at the end.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi lokwamukelwa likukhombisa uhlelo olwelulwe esifundweni sakho sokuqala: unyaka owodwa owengeziwe, neziqu ezifanayo ekugcineni.

tip.en: Extended programmes add a foundation year for students who were a few points short. Ask admissions whether you qualify.
tip.zu: Izinhlelo ezelulwe zengeza unyaka wesisekelo kubafundi abasweleke amaphuzu ambalwa. Buza ehhovisi lokwamukelwa ukuthi uyafanelekela yini.

label.en: Rewrite, and apply again next year
label.zu: Bhala kabusha, bese ufaka isicelo futhi ngonyaka ozayo

outcome.en: You won't start university this year. You'll rewrite the subjects you need, and apply again next year for the course you really want.
outcome.zu: Ngeke uqale inyuvesi kulo nyaka. Uzobhala kabusha izifundo ozidingayo, bese ufaka isicelo futhi ngonyaka ozayo sesifundo osifuna ngempela.

tip.en: Ask your school how to register for the supplementary or Second Chance exams, and when registration closes. Then check when applications for next year open.
tip.zu: Buza esikoleni sakho ukuthi ubhalisela kanjani izivivinyo ezengeziwe noma ze-Second Chance, nokuthi ukubhalisa kuvalwa nini. Bese uhlola ukuthi izicelo zonyaka ozayo zivulwa nini.

text.en: The one university you applied to has put you on a waiting list. Classes start in five weeks.
text.zu: Inyuvesi eyodwa ofake kuyo isicelo ikubeke ohlwini lokulinda. Izifundo ziqala emasontweni amahlanu.

outcome.en: You plan a year of work and reapplying. A gap year with a plan is not a failure.
outcome.zu: Uhlela unyaka wokusebenza nokufaka isicelo futhi. Unyaka wokuphumula onohlelo awukona ukwehluleka.

outcome.en: A TVET college near you offers a related qualification, with funding. It's a real route, not a consolation prize.
outcome.zu: Ikolishi le-TVET eliseduze linikeza iziqu ezihlobene, ezinoxhaso. Kuyindlela yangempela, hhayi umklomelo wokududuza.

tip.en: TVET colleges take applications on their websites or at the campus, and NSFAS funds TVET students too.
tip.zu: Amakolishi e-TVET amukela izicelo kumawebhusayithi awo noma ekhampasi, futhi i-NSFAS ixhasa nabafundi be-TVET.

outcome.en: You register with the national clearing house for late applications and call the faculty. A space opens.
outcome.zu: Ubhalisa nesikhungo sikazwelonke sezicelo eziphuzile futhi ushayela ifakhalthi. Kuvuleka isikhala.

tip.en: Ask your school or the higher education department about the clearing house for applicants without a place.
tip.zu: Buza esikoleni sakho noma emnyangweni wemfundo ephakeme ngesikhungo sabafake izicelo abangenandawo.

text.en: "We are pleased to offer you a place." You read it four times, then send a screenshot to everyone you know.
text.zu: "Siyajabula ukukunikeza indawo." Uyifunda kane, bese uthumela isithombe-skrini kuwo wonke umuntu omaziyo.

text.en: A university has an online "day in the life" you can try before you choose.
text.zu: Inyuvesi ine-"usuku empilweni" ku-inthanethi ongaluzama ngaphambi kokukhetha.

outcome.en: Now you know which questions to ask at the open day.
outcome.zu: Manje uyazi ukuthi yimiphi imibuzo ozoyibuza ngosuku oluvulekile.

outcome.en: It stays in your tabs. Applications close in three weeks.
outcome.zu: Kuhlala kumathebhu akho. Izicelo zivalwa emasontweni amathathu.

text.en: A parent asks how much university will really cost. You're not sure.
text.zu: Umzali ubuza ukuthi inyuvesi izobiza malini ngempela. Awuqiniseki.

outcome.en: Fees, rent, food, transport: seeing the total makes the plan real.
outcome.zu: Izimali, irenti, ukudla, ukugibela: ukubona isamba kwenza uhlelo lube ngokoqobo.

outcome.en: They nod, but they're still worried. So are you.
outcome.zu: Bayavuma ngekhanda, kodwa basakhathazekile. Nawe ngokunjalo.

text.en: You'll be living away from home. Do you know what the room comes with, and what you must bring?
text.zu: Uzohlala kude nekhaya. Uyazi ukuthi ikamelo liza nani, nokuthi yini okufanele uyilethe?

outcome.en: The residence office, or your landlord, sends it: bring bedding, a lock, plates and a pot. It also says which appliances aren't allowed.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala, noma umnikazi wendlu, bayaluthumela: letha izingubo zokulala, ingidi, amapuleti nebhodwe. Lusho nokuthi yiziphi izinto zikagesi ezingavunyelwe.

outcome.en: You arrive with a kettle you can't use and no bedding. Res WhatsApp groups sell second-hand basics cheaply.
outcome.zu: Ufika neketela ongeke ulisebenzise futhi ungenazo izingubo zokulala. Amaqembu e-WhatsApp e-res athengisa izinto ezisetshenzisiwe ngentengo ephansi.
